latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of DevLog Generator.

- Generate narrative developer blog posts from coding session transcripts, narrated by the agent.
- Automatically scans supported platforms for session data and filters relevant sessions based on project, topic, style, and time range.
- Aggressively filters transcript data to highlight human-agent collaboration and technical decisions.
- Adapts blog structure and style (builder’s log, tutorial, or technical deep-dive) to match user preference and session content.
- Supports publishing generated blogs to multiple online platforms with optional AI-generated cover images.
- Includes detailed edge case handling for various data and publishing scenarios.
